summary: Reviewed src/retry-policy.ts without changing files. Found one correctness issue. TypeScript validation passed.
observations: Medium — src/retry-policy.ts:1 retries every numeric value >= 500, including invalid HTTP statuses such as 600, 700, and Infinity. If the policy intends to retry HTTP 5xx responses, the condition should be bounded at 599. Runtime verification confirmed these values currently return true.
The repository does not document whether callers guarantee a valid HTTP status, so the practical reachability of invalid values is unsupported.
